items.title: VeilFarers Corebook
items.description: Character creation, the Pearl Era, powers, equipment, augmentations and starship combat. The foundation for players and Keepers.

items.title: VeilFarers Keeper's Companion
items.description: Prepare sessions, build NPCs, manage pressure with clocks and bring the Shattered Worlds to life.

items.title: Hearts in the Void
items.description: A missing heir, a crossing through the Veil and a silent station. Adventure 1.0, updated to rules 12.06.

items.title: VeilFarers: Rust & Steel
items.description: Weapons, armor, equipment and survival. Expand the technology and hard choices available to your crew.

items.title: VeilFarers: Alien Species
items.description: Explore the peoples of the Shattered Worlds through biology, culture, NPCs and tools for inter-species encounters.

items.title: VeilFarers Starship Sheet
items.description: Two-page printable starship sheet: shield arcs and Armor Slots, Hull and Heat tracks, ship Systems and Weapons, Sensor Lock, Drive Modes, class stats and range bands.

items.title: VeilFarers Fillable Character Sheet
items.description: Editable two-page physical character sheet with 186 fillable form fields.

items.title: First Crossing
items.description: A complete first session for 3–5 players and one Keeper, designed for 3–4 hours. Includes starter rules and a route into Hearts in the Void. Requires the companion Table Kit.
items.coverAlt: Maya Santos presents a blue three-dimensional hologram of Alexei Joric.

items.title: First Crossing — Table Kit
items.description: Player references, Keeper cards, five Level 1 character folios, sealed continuation handouts and four printer-friendly map plates. Companion to First Crossing 1.1.
items.coverAlt: A three-panel Keeper screen with character folios, reference cards and two twelve-sided dice.

items.title: First Crossing — Color Maps
items.description: Four map plates for screen use or optional color printing: Harrow Dock, Dock K-17, Charon’s Refuge and its docking ring.
items.coverAlt: A composition of four color map plates: station overview, docking ring, acquisition yard and hangar.

pdfCandidateStatus: Five books updated to 12.06. First Crossing 1.1 includes a starter session, required Table Kit and optional color maps. Existing character and starship sheets retain their stated versions.
